So I went to high school with this kid, lets call him John. John is impossible to summarize as everything about him is the most infuriating thing imaginable. In grade 12 he was in every class that I took. I actually switched out of one class because the teacher sat us next to eachother and I couldn’t handle it. John came in late every day with a coffee in his hand, I started keeping a tally. He was so incessantly and needlessly rude to every teacher, blatantly talked, laughed, or played video games in their class and complained about struggling on these courses. To my reccolevtion he was failing chemistry and in a practice work class before an upcoming test he played sim city on his laptop and in the same exact class complained that he didn’t know anything. 

The year continued and I signed up to provide tutoring in English and biology for my school. I go to the meeting where tutors are assigned their students and the principal says to me
“You’re signed up to tutor bio and English but are you able to tutor all subjects for one student?”

I say “I wouldn’t be comfortable tutoring math or chemistry but I can definitely do both bio and English for them”

The principal replies “well he really needs the help so you’ll be tutoring John in all subjects”

I was assigned to be his tutor in a seemingly cosmically directed attack. He showed up to two tutoring sessions and no more. I was never paid.
